old_caption: The video captures a dynamic display of fireworks exploding in the night sky. The fireworks illuminate the darkness with bursts of light in various colors—shades of red, green, white, and blue—creating a festive scene. The camera moves to follow the action, focusing on the fireworks as they explode and leave trails of smoke. The overall effect is one of celebration, with the fireworks illuminating the darkness and creating a vibrant visual experience.
original_wisa_caption: The video captures a vibrant display of fireworks against a dark night sky. The fireworks burst in various colors—shades of red, green, blue, and white—creating a dazzling spectacle. Each burst is followed by a shower of sparks and smoke, which gradually dissipates into the night air. The camera remains stationary throughout the sequence, focusing on the fireworks as they explode in succession. The intensity and frequency of the explosions vary, with some bursts being more powerful and expansive than others. The overall effect is one of celebration and festivity, with the fireworks illuminating the darkness and creating a mesmerizing visual experience.
caption: The video captures a night sky already saturated with the lingering curved trails of a large firework display, woven in red, white-green and purple-blue and dotted with grayish smoke puffs. This dense network occupies the whole frame throughout, fading in places as spark points drift downward. Within it, a yellow-white starburst flares at center-right, radiates outward and fades into the surrounding trails. A brief white flash with short purple streaks pops near the center, followed by small star-shaped bursts at upper-right and left-center. A bright starburst then ignites at center, expanding into a larger radiating pink-and-white glow before dissolving, while another burst forms lower-center and spreads. The trail pattern and smoke fade across the clip.
